title: Troubleshooting čvorova i komponenti klastera
summary: Dijagnostika čvorova u stanju NotReady (kubelet, containerd, CNI, certifikati, pritisak resursa) i komponenti kontrolne ravni preko systemctl, journalctl, crictl i static Pod manifesta.
summary_en: Diagnosing NotReady nodes (kubelet, containerd, CNI, certificates, resource pressure) and control plane components using systemctl, journalctl, crictl and static Pod manifests.
